title: andryala rosea
intro: Andryala rosea, commonly known as the Rock Rose, is a perennial herbaceous plant that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which can help alleviate pain and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rock Rose include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, promoting relaxation and reducing anxiety. The bioactive constituents responsible for its properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities.
